issues: The draft does not state the condition behind the protected amount: principal is protected up to 10 million yen per depositor per financial institution. It should confirm that both totals (800,000 yen and 700,000 yen) are within that cap.
It does not say that Mayuri's floating-rate time deposit is also a general deposit and fully protected. This is a likely trap, so the reason is under-explained.
It does not say that the ordinary deposits are not settlement-purpose deposits, and so fall under the 10-million-yen cap. The problem's own note says this.
The reason the 4 million yen education endowment insurance (学資保険) is excluded should be explained: it is an insurance product, not a deposit, even if bought through a bank.
suggestedCorrection: explanation: Deposit insurance protects general yen deposits (ordinary and time deposits, fixed or floating rate) up to 10 million yen of principal plus interest per depositor per institution. Foreign-currency deposits, investment trusts and insurance products are not covered. (ア) 孝義: ordinary 300,000 + fixed-rate time 500,000 = 800,000 yen. The 600,000 investment trust and the 4 million education insurance are not covered. Within the cap, so 80万円. (イ) 真由利: ordinary 100,000 + floating-rate time 600,000 = 700,000 yen. The 400,000 foreign-currency deposit is not covered. Within the cap, so 70万円.
